description: Three-letter IATA airport code. Codes identify the same airport across the twelve monthly records.
Historical airport name and location associated with the code. The reference labels reflect the 2015 reporting period.
Reporting period written as YYYY/MM. The records are arranged by month, then by airport code within each month.
Calendar month number, from 1 for January through 12 for December.
English name of the reporting month, corresponding to the month number and period label.
Four-digit reporting year. This release covers January through December 2015.

Monthly number of delays attributed to carrier operations, such as crew, maintenance or aircraft servicing. Counts summarize the airport-month and retain the reference export’s integer representation.
Monthly number of delays attributed to the late arrival of an aircraft from its previous flight. Counts summarize the airport-month and retain the reference export’s integer representation.

Monthly number of delays attributed to national airspace and airport operations, including traffic management and congestion. Counts summarize the airport-month and retain the reference export’s integer representation.
Monthly number of delays attributed to security screening or a security-related interruption. Counts summarize the airport-month and retain the reference export’s integer representation.
Monthly number of delays attributed to weather-related operational disruption. Counts summarize the airport-month and retain the reference export’s integer representation.
Comma-separated roster of carriers represented in this airport’s monthly statistics. Names use the historical reference vocabulary.
Number of carrier names in the reporting roster for this airport and month.
Monthly count of flights recorded as cancelled at this airport.
Monthly count of flights recorded as delayed. Cause-specific counts may have small rounding differences when compared with this figure.
Monthly count of flights recorded as diverted from their scheduled destination.
Monthly count of flights recorded as on time at this airport.
Monthly total across the cancelled, delayed, diverted and on-time flight categories.
Monthly delay duration in minutes attributed to carrier operations, such as crew, maintenance or aircraft servicing. This is a duration total, rather than the number of affected flights.
Monthly delay duration in minutes attributed to the late arrival of an aircraft from its previous flight. This is a duration total, rather than the number of affected flights.

Monthly delay duration in minutes attributed to national airspace and airport operations, including traffic management and congestion. This is a duration total, rather than the number of affected flights.
Monthly delay duration in minutes attributed to security screening or a security-related interruption. This is a duration total, rather than the number of affected flights.
Combined delay duration in minutes across the five reported cause categories.
Monthly delay duration in minutes attributed to weather-related operational disruption. This is a duration total, rather than the number of affected flights.
